To both parties: this decides the $4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02702. The fee stands and the driver is paid $3.60.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties: this decides the $4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02702. The fee stands and the driver is paid $3.60. WHY THE FEE STANDS (POL-NS-01, all four limbs). (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:55:03. (b) The GPS trace places him inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (Tampines Mall) - 42 qualifying in-geofence fixes, which answers POL-NS-02. (c) He then held position in one continuous in-geofence run of 409 seconds, 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set), and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) The trip was terminated at 17:01:56 under RIDER_NO_SHOW - after the 180-second dwell elapsed at 16:58:03 - with no boarding event recorded. TO THE RIDER. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. It needs all three limbs. Limb (a) is arguable on your 16:57:23 message 'coming down now' and limb (b) is met by the driver's silence, but limb (c) fails affirmatively: your own device is tracked at 853.9-861.4 m from the pickup pin throughout, with zero fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a large venue. With (c) failed the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01, as your own rider-track claim acknowledged. The chat therefore corroborates the driver: more than two minutes into the wait you were still not at the pickup point. POL-NS-03 does not apply either - the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. TO THE DRIVER. Your payout is 80% of the $4.50 fee = $3.60, fixed by POL-NS-07 and matching the money block (4.50 x 0.8). The anti-farming check on your profile does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the 4-or-more limb, so compensation is paid and the fee stands. CHECKS THAT DID NOT DISPLACE THE FEE. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is genuine - at 16:55:03 the driver's nearest fix is 0.16 m from the pin and stationary - so the waiting clock runs from the marker and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06: there is no shortfall, 409 seconds exceeding the 180-second minimum, so no refund arises and no advisory-accumulation is needed. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so arrival is established on the exported trace itself. POL-NS-11: the rider's track is not evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not impair his trace. INTEGRITY AND WEIGHT (POL-GEN-02). The only artifact below weight 1.0 is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02702-01 (MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); it is cited only for its absence and carries no deciding fact, so it does not cap confidence. The artifacts that do carry the deciding facts - EV-GPS-02702, EV-TRIP-02702 and EV-FARE-02702 - all sit at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0; my confidence is 0.90. The ledger reconciles to the policy figure under POL-NS-08(d) (charged 4.50 = platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so no integrity ground to refund arises. NO ESCALATION, NO REFERRAL. No artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; no integrity limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged; no profile-counter condition for review is met; and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically unless appealed under POL-GEN-04.
To the rider: your dispute is not upheld. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged in EV-FARE-02702 (cancellation_fee line 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED) stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60. To the driver: your fee is confirmed and your payout is fixed below. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 are met. (a) EV-TRIP-02702 records the driver's 'I'm Here' arrival event at 16:55:03. (b) EV-GPS-02702 places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at and before that moment: 42 consecutive qualifying fixes (qualifying_fix_count 42), nearest fix 0.16 m from the pin (driver_track.min_distance_m 0.157 m). (c) He then held a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 409 seconds, 16:55:03 to 17:01:52 (longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec 409), measured from the first qualifying GPS fix as the clause requires, exceeding the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 17:01:56 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event. The rider's POL-NS-04 argument is rejected. Limbs (a) and (b) do hold: the rider's 'coming down now' message at 16:57:23 (EV-CHAT-02702) is a coordinating message inside the waiting window, and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made any in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). But limb (c) is affirmatively failed: the rider's own track records 69 fixes, all stationary, at 853.883 m to 861.377 m from the pickup pin (rider_presence.min_distance_m / max_distance_m), with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). POL-NS-04 states that where limb (c) is affirmatively failed the clause does not apply, so the driver's silence does not convert this into a driver-side coordination failure. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m. The rider's point that registered_pickup_points is 1 and that no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises is correct but moot. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival marker the driver was 0.16 m from the pin and stationary, so the marker is not false.
